title: DetectionJob
description: Configuration for an anomaly detection job that analyzes one or more time series using a specified algorithm and detection settings.

id.description: Unique identifier for the detection job.

name.description: Human-readable name for the detection job.

description.description: Description of what this detection job monitors and why.
description.example: Monitors API p99 latency for anomalies using daily seasonality.

status.description: Current operational status of the detection job.

algorithm.description: The anomaly detection algorithm used by this job.

mode.description: Detection mode — batch retrospective, streaming real-time, or multivariate correlation-based.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity level controlling the anomaly detection threshold. Higher values detect more subtle anomalies.

seasonality.description: Seasonality pattern used for baseline modeling.

series_ids.description: List of time series identifiers analyzed by this job.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the job was created.

modified_at.description: Timestamp when the job was last modified.
